review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Role As a Systems Administrator at Air Apps, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining corporate IT infrastructure, user access, and SaaS tools to ensure a secure and efficient work environment. Responsibilities Manage and maintain corporate IT infrastructure, including SaaS applications, cloud services, and internal systems. eligibility_evidence: This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role requires technical expertise in IT systems, cloud-based tools, and security best practices to optimize and scale internal operations. Proficiency in identity and access management (IAM) tools (Okta, Azure AD, JumpCloud).
